content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Kenyan creators

This infrastructure works by decoupling payment processing from traditional platforms. By leveraging [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-which-architecture|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]]'s global network and NOWPayments' cryptocurrency processing, you can collect payments directly from your customers without relying on intermediaries. This approach not only saves you money but also gives you full control over your payment and delivery pipeline. With this infrastructure, you can process transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, giving you a competitive edge in the global market.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying this infrastructure, you will need a few essential tools: a Cloudflare account, a NOWPayments account, and a basic understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain technology. You will also need to set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account to host your payment and delivery pipeline. With these tools in place, you can start building your sovereign payment and delivery infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages both provide free static site hosting that works identically regardless of where the store operator is located. A store deployed on Cloudflare Pages by a creator in Harare is served from Cloudflare's global edge network — the same infrastructure that serves enterprises in New York. Neither platform imposes geographic restrictions on who can deploy a store or who can access it. Combined with NOWPayments for payment processing and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, this creates a complete commerce infrastructure with zero hosting costs and no geographic restrictions at any layer of the stack.
By decoupling payment processing from traditional platforms, you can save money and gain full control over your payment and delivery pipeline.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Creators in Ethiopia, Cameroon, Tanzania, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and the Philippines face a compounded challenge: not only are conventional payment platforms unavailable, but local banking infrastructure may add additional friction to receiving international transfers through alternative channels. Crypto payments remove this layer entirely. A seller in Addis Ababa and a seller in Amsterdam receive USDT transactions through the same NOWPayments infrastructure, at the same speed, with the same 0.5% fee. The blockchain has no knowledge of which country a wallet is located in. The webhook fires to both backends identically. Geographic neutrality is not a feature — it is the fundamental property of how blockchains work.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running, you can scale your payment and delivery pipeline to meet the demands of your growing customer base. This involves configuring your payment settings, optimizing your delivery pipeline, and monitoring your transactions. With this infrastructure, you can process transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, giving you a competitive edge in the global market.

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
With this infrastructure, you can process transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, giving you a competitive edge in the global market.

This complete documentation provides full source code, NOWPayments integration guides, and scaling playbooks for all 5 stacks. Additionally, you can find more information on our products and services at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this infrastructure, follow these steps: create a Cloudflare account and set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account; integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages account; set up a payment gateway, create a delivery pipeline, and configure your payment and delivery settings; configure your payment settings, test your delivery pipeline, and confirm your transactions; and finally, optimize your delivery pipeline and monitor your transactions.
Frequently Asked Questions
Do I need to have a basic understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain technology to deploy this infrastructure?

While a basic understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain technology is helpful, it is not necessary. This guide provides a comprehensive walkthrough of the infrastructure setup process, making it accessible to creators with little to no technical expertise.
Can I use this infrastructure to process transactions in other countries besides Kenya?
Yes, this infrastructure is designed to be country-agnostic, allowing you to process transactions in any country where NOWPayments is available.
What is the fee for processing transactions using this infrastructure?
The fee for processing transactions using this infrastructure is under $0.10 for USDT on Tron, making it an extremely cost-effective solution for creators.
Can I use this infrastructure to deliver digital products besides ebooks and courses?
Yes, this infrastructure can be used to deliver any type of digital product, including software, plugins, and fonts.
Is this infrastructure secure?
Yes, this infrastructure is built on Cloudflare's global network and NOWPayments' secure cryptocurrency processing, making it a highly secure solution for creators.
